Avengement (2019) | Action Crime Thriller

While on prison furlough, low-level criminal Cain Burgess (Scott Adkins) escapes his guards and takes a high-class private club hostage. Through tense, non-linear flashbacks, Cain reveals to his captors—members of his own brother’s crime syndicate—how he was set up, betrayed, and forced to survive years in a maximum-security prison that transformed him into an unstoppable force. Driven by severe physical disfigurement and a lifetime of exploitation, he seeks a final, brutal reckoning with the family that used and abandoned him.

Beyond the relentless physical violence, the film delves into heavy themes of revenge, betrayal, generational crime, and moral degeneration. It explores the toxic impact of toxic family ties and how institutional environments like prison can strip away a person's humanity, forcing them to become the very monster their abusers created.

Avengement transcends the standard straight-to-video martial arts genre by delivering a gritty, dialogue-driven narrative with strong noir influences. Scott Adkins delivers a remarkably nuanced performance, elevating a classic payback narrative into a tragic, dark character study about a man confronting the futility and cost of vengeance.

Can revenge ever offer true closure to someone whose life has been entirely ruined by betrayal, or does it just complete their self-destruction? Drop your thoughts below! 👇

source_details.synopsis: Avengement is a 2019 British action thriller film directed by Jesse V. Johnson who co-wrote the film with Stu Small. The film stars Scott Adkins, Craig Fairbrass and Thomas Turgoose. Avengement was released on 24 May 2019 on VOD and in selected theatres, where it received generally positive reviews from critics with praise for its action choreography and Adkins' performance. In 2020, a special edition was released, which contains an uncut version of the film.
